chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ibn Mahbub from Abu Wallad al-Hannat said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about the deceased making a bequest to the heir, and he said, 'It is permissible.'
ai.seo_question: Is it permissible for a deceased person to leave a bequest to one of their heirs in Shia Islam?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) confirms the validity of a bequest to an heir, resolving the juristic debate regarding whether such a gift is considered part of the fixed inheritance shares or an additional gift. This ruling is particularly significant in Shia jurisprudence as it allows heirs to receive extra portions beyond their statutory shares, provided the bequest does not exceed one-third of the estate and is made during sound health. The permissibility underscores the flexibility of Islamic estate planning while maintaining the integrity of the Quranic inheritance distribution.
